chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Fazalat ibn Ayoub, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, Ammar, who said:

I saw the Abd al-Salih (peace be upon him) enter the Kaaba, so he prayed two cycles upon the red marble slab. Then he stood and faced the wall between the Yemeni corner and the Western corner, so his hand fell upon it and adhered to it, and he supplicated. Then he moved to the Yemeni corner, so he adhered to it and supplicated. Then he went to the Western corner, then he went out.

key_terms.الرُّخَامَةِ الْحَمْرَاءِ: The red marble slab, a specific stone surface inside the Kaaba
key_terms.الرُّكْنَ الْغَرْبِيَّ: The Western corner of the Kaaba
key_terms.الرُّكْنِ الْيَمَانِيِّ: The Yemeni corner, one of the four main corners of the Kaaba
key_terms.الْعَبْدَ الصَّالِحَ: The Abd al-Salih (The Servant of God), a title for the 7th Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him)
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةَ: The Kaaba, the cube-shaped building in Mecca
key_terms.لَزِقَ بِهِ: He adhered/clung to it, describing the physical act of holding the wall during supplication

ai.seo_question: What specific ritual actions did the 7th Imam perform inside the Kaaba according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the ritual significance of the Kaaba's interior, specifically the Rukn al-Yamani and the Western corner, as sites for intimate supplication (dua) and physical connection with the sacred structure. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the Imam’s exemplary practice (sunnah) in utilizing these specific architectural elements for spiritual elevation, reinforcing the Kaaba not just as a direction of prayer but as a locus of divine encounter. The act of 'adhering' his hand suggests a deep, tactile devotion that transcends mere circumambulation.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said,

‘I saw Al-Abd Al-Salihasws (7th Imamasws) enter the Kabah. So heasws Prayed two Cycles of Salaat upon the red marble slab. Then heasws stood and faced the wall between Al-Yamani corner and Al-Gharby. So heasws placed hisasws hand upon it, and adhere with it, and supplicated. Then heasws transferred to Al-Yamani corner, so heasws adhered with it and supplicated. Then heasws went to Al-Gharby corner, then went out’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following:

“I saw (Allah’s) virtuous servant, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, enter al-Ka‘bah and perform two Rak‘at Salat (prayer) on the red marble, then stand up and face the wall between al-Yemaniy and western corners. He (the Imam) placed his hand on it and wiped and prayed, then turned to al-Yemaniy corner, touched it and prayed, then he (the Imam) came to the western corner and went out.”
